notes.title: Vampire Therapist: Couples Therapy is ready for love!
notes.content:
Howdy, cowpokes! We've got a juicy update for you today.

[h1]Couples Therapy DLC Released[/h1]

We're delighted to announce the release of [i]Vampire Therapist: Couples Therapy[/i]! Step back into the spurred boots of Sam Walls, now a vampire therapist extraordinaire, and help an undead couple find peace with one another. We're delighted to bring you more of the award-winning Vampire Therapist world and can't wait to you to sink your teeth into our new adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/3963265ece718d22886f14735399dcc03fcd240a.png[/img]

You'll meet two vampires who died fighting oppression with very different takes on what it means to struggle against entrenched political powers. This, of course, cannot be compared to any modern world events. 

In between sessions, you'll solve a mystery involving the long-dead composer of Leipzig, Johann Sebastian Bach. It's a musical journey you won't want to miss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/1e43e784eb43b8f05ab1e3d8104287a1c8d0f85f.jpg[/img]

And for those of you who have asked whether Sam will get a chance at love … well, maybe. If you play your cards right.

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

We fixed a good number of minor bugs in the game, including character positioning cleanups and correcting some font issues. Now we can properly display French characters!

[h1]Future Plans[/h1]

We're already hard at work on pre-production for our next game, and we can't wait to share more with you. We can promise that there's no game like it already!

We'll also have some exciting Vampire Therapist news in the near future. Keep watching this space and we'll keep you in the loop!

-----------

If you know a content creator who would enjoy playing Vampire Therapist: Couples Therapy, let us know on our discord or just send us an email. We're eager to share our world with anyone who will listen!

We appreciate all your support and hope you'll have tons of fun in couples therapy. Happy Early Valentine's day!

The Little Bat Games Team

notes.title: Free Story Update: Fathoms Below
notes.content:
Howdy pardners! We've got some fun stuff for ya this month.

[h1]Free Story Update[/h1]

Today we're releasing the last free story update exploring the history of Andromachos, our mentor and hot vampire stereotype.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/f8fa4918fdc52bbee4393fb90e8e20cc02f7c90c.png[/img]

What makes a vampire put meaningless murder behind them? What dark secrets can they learn when they don't need to breathe? And what was the deal with Sigmund Freud and his mother? Find out in this story update, and give an elder vampire an emotional release!

I also fixed a bug where resolutions wouldn't save. I listen!!

[h1]Awards 'n' Honors[/h1]

Little Bat Games is a hyper-tiny studio, with one solo dev and a team of contract artists, editors, and support programmers. But we've been making waves here at the end of the year!

We've picked up an [url=https://indiex.online/]Indie X Award[/url] for Best Game for a Better World and were in their top 5 games among all more than 600 submitted games.

We picked up a [url=https://deutscherentwicklerpreis.de/nominierte-gewinner/]German Developer Prize[/url] for Best Game Beyond Entertainment where we got to get all dressed up and do a speech.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/e8daa8cf9e612f7947a402ad0621f6d5a5c24287.jpg[/img]

And last week, we were added to the [url=https://www.bafta.org/media-centre/press-releases/bafta-announces-2025-bafta-games-awards-longlist]BAFTA Game Awards longlist[/url] in the Best Game Beyond Entertainment category.

We're honored to be contending with big studios when it took us three tries to make curtains work properly!

Your support is hugely helpful right now to give us visibility, so if Vampire Therapist affected you in some way, please share and help us build a groundswell... we still hope to make Vampire Therapist 2 if we can make our money back!

[h1]DLC coming soon[/h1]

Don't forget to wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320590/Vampire_Therapist__Couples_Therapy]Vampire Therapist: Couples Therapy[/url]! Ring in 2025 by sorting out our collective resentment over wealth inequality and finding some peace in our relationships.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320590/Vampire_Therapist__Couples_Therapy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/c3a4e2f5abb4b3be8538726f6aa8170aab58a582.png[/img][/url]

When the nights are long, this is the time for vampires to seek love. Maybe even cowboy vampires. 

[h1]Yeah, but what else though?[/h1]

What else?! Well, if you want, you could go play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145350/Hades_II/]Hades 2[/url] (I'm back as Dionysus), and we've been consulting with Com8Com1 on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747550/Bloodshed/]Bloodshed [/url]for both writing and voiceover. One of the playable characters sounds like Sam might before he found his peace. It's a first person Vampire Survivors boomer shooter with snarky hero quips, just like the 90s used to make, out now in Early Access!

Thank you for coming on this ride with us, and we'll see you cowpokes in 2025!

Love,
Cyrus and the Little Bat Games team

notes.title: The Minigames Patch
notes.content:
Greetings, dear immortals!

We're going on a much-needed vacation, but we've got a patch for you before we get our not-so-eternal rest.

[h2][h1]Minigames Overhaul[/h1][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/40b043f3f9b16f9106e8bf0f08bbbb7fdfcb80ac.png[/img]

We've added better tutorialization to our minigames, so now it should be easy to jump in and start biting some necks or having some deep thoughts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/cca109995a99021c4b95759e1d876cfa2a2a3ac7.png[/img]

And if you're after a more relaxed experience with no minigames at all, you can just skip them and get right to the therapizing.

[h2]Respectful Flirting[/h2]

We got some frequent feedback that our club goths were coming on a little strong. Vampire sexuality is a playful running joke in Vampire Therapist (consent is important!), but it was misread in this case, so we had our friendly bartender cut in a little early.

[h2]Odd and ends[/h2]

A couple more fixes just for your enjoyment.

* Club sound propagation is corrected in one location
* Character positioning improved during dance scene

[h2]Last Day of Sale[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/638faa7373b8015e9148eac68e587af77f6b2ec8.png[/img]

Today is the last day Vampire Therapist is on sale for spooky season. Please spread the word if Vampire Therapist made you feel a little bit better about the world or yourself! We're a small studio and your support helps us far more than you could imagine.

Happy biting, children of the night!

notes.title: "Couples Therapy" Is coming to Vampire Therapist + Free Content Update
notes.content:
[h1]Two new clients with lots of problems[/h1]

What if "till death do us part" meant [i]forever[/i]? Find out in Vampire Therapist: Couple Therapy DLC, coming soon to Steam!

[previewyoutube=xjVPzVaSWVI;full][/previewyoutube]

You'll get the chance to handle two clients at the same time in a story of revolutions, relationships, and leaving filthy glasses of blood overnight in the sink.

[h1]Free Content Update[/h1]

You don't have to wait for new content, because the second free content update in our series exploring the history of 3000-year-old vampire Andromachos is out today! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838963/64aca4d220a2d6185fcf96fff55b466502477fe0.png[/img]

In "Spanish Nights", discover what happens when an ancient vampire when he visits Spain in 1492. Hint: there's a lot of blood involved.

[h1]Baby vampire's first discount[/h1]

For the first time, Vampire Therapist has been discounted! You can now experience the journey of self-compassion at a lower price, meaning it's a great gift for that person in your life who thinks they're too good for therapy. 

[h1]Award Nominations[/h1]

Vampire Therapist has been nominated for the [url=https://indiex.online]2024 Indie X Awards[/url] and the [url=https://deutscherentwicklerpreis.de/deutscher-entwicklerpreis-nominiert-die-besten-games-2024/]2024 German Developer Awards[/url]! We couldn't get here without your support. 

That's all! We can't wait to share more with you, dear children of the night.

notes.title: It's Curtains For You
notes.content:
Greetings, children of the night! 

We've got a special new patch you all today. You know how Vampire Therapist has a reputation as "that really cool and funny game with the wonky curtains?" Well, now the curtains are fixed!

Why did it take this long? Well, Vampire Therapist is largely a solo project and I'm not an experienced programmer. Apparently embedding video with transparency will make most computers melt. So now we use a green screen effect to render the curtains opening and closing instead. Neat!

Further patch notes:

[list]
[*]Updates the curtains to use a greenscreen — should work much better on slower machines!
[*]Ensures players can't save during Distortion picking. Sorry, my dear therapists, have confidence and commit to your choices! 
[*]Lots of setup for upcoming content and upcoming demo
[/list]
That's all this time. Thanks for your patience, bloodsucking buddies!

Love,
Cyrus

notes.title: Free Content Update
notes.content:
Greetings, immortal therapists!

Today, we launch the first in a series of free content updates that will give you the chance to ease the mental burdens of Andromachos, our 3000-year-old vampire. 

These [b]short sessions[/b] (30-60 minutes each) are our thank you to players who have purchased and completed Vampire Therapist. We think you're awesome and want to give you something good!

The first session releasing today, "The Blood of Troy," will let you explore how Andromachos became a vampire. It involves a gigantic horse.

Stay tuned for more soon!

Rest in peace,
Little Bat Games

notes.title: Vampire Therapist August 2 Patch: "It's Curtains for you!"
notes.content:
Howdy, healers of the unholy! We've got a big set of fixes for you today, so we'll call it a full on patch. Here are the changes:

[list]
[*] New tutorial for the meditation minigame and updated prompts
[*] Full curtain reimplementation that should make the experience even more theatrical than it already is
[*] Fixes loud sounds while picking distortions (I know, sorry)
[*] Updated content warning
[*] More consistent blood reactions when picking distortions
[*] Simplified the Slow Learner achievement - it can now be triggered after finishing all second client sessions.
[*] Adds notifications for saved checkpoints
[*] Cleanup of unnecessary settings buttons
[*] Makes music controls more consistent
[*] Fixes meditation controls on the Steam Deck
[*] Fixes random premature ending in Isabella's second session
[*] Fixes VO takes in Isabella's 3rd session and Drayne's 4th session
[*] Retimes the intro slightly
[*] Fixes Sam and Meddy's ventriloquism act in her 4th session
[*] Cleans a dirty neck
[*] Fixes an anachronism in the journal
[/list]

Note that some coffin videos may not work properly for Steam Deck users, but we're looking into fixes for that.

Stay tuned for some more bloodwarming updates in a few weeks!
